article.headline: Scores from last Night: Carruth scores 22 in Parklane win; Lewisburg edges Madison Central
article.html:
Carlyle Carruth scored 22 points as Parklane Academy held off Amite School Center 41–36 on Tuesday, October 27. On the soccer field, Lewisburg’s girls broke a halftime tie to beat Madison Central 2–1, while Saltillo and Starkville traded boys and girls victories.

Carruth helps Parklane reach 2–0

Parklane’s win kept the Pioneers unbeaten at 2–0. Carruth finished with 22 points in the neutral-site tournament game, while Amite School Center finished 0–2.

Simpson Academy also moved to 2–0, beating Silliman Institute 61–15. The Cougars led 23–5 after the first quarter and outscored Silliman 17–6 in the second. Madison-Ridgeland Academy opened with a 49–15 win over Cathedral, taking a 15–3 lead in the first quarter. Our previous morning roundup has more early-season basketball coverage.

Russell posts a double-double for Hattiesburg HomeSchool

Hattiesburg HomeSchool won 66–44 at Bowling Green in Franklinton, Louisiana, with Keller Russell recording 26 points, 10 rebounds and six assists. The Forerunners gained ground through the middle quarters, outscoring Bowling Green 22–13 in the second and 22–14 in the third. Hattiesburg HomeSchool finished 3–0.

Lewisburg and Southaven girls add soccer wins

Lewisburg’s girls and Madison Central were tied 1–1 at halftime. The Patriots scored the only goal after the break to secure a 2–1 win and a 1–0 start. Lewisburg’s boys also opened with a win, beating Olive Branch 7–0 on the road.

Southaven’s girls won 3–0 at South Panola, scoring twice before halftime and once afterward. The Chargers moved to 3–0. The boys match finished 1–1, leaving Southaven unbeaten at 2–0–1 and South Panola at 0–0–1.

Saltillo and Starkville split their soccer matches

Saltillo’s girls edged Starkville 4–3 in a match decided by a single goal. The Tigers finished 1–0, with Starkville at 0–1. The boys result went the other way: Starkville won 3–1 at Saltillo, giving the Yellowjackets a 1–0 start and leaving Saltillo 0–1.

Biloxi boys break through after halftime

Biloxi’s boys won 1–0 at Long Beach after the teams reached halftime scoreless. The Indians scored the only goal in the second half and finished 3–0. Long Beach’s girls won 2–0 over Biloxi, opening their schedule with a shutout.

Brandon takes both matches at Warren Central

Brandon’s girls stayed unbeaten at 3–0 with a 7–0 victory at Warren Central. The Bulldogs’ boys won 3–1, scoring all their goals before halftime. Warren Central scored once after the break, but Brandon’s first-half lead held up for a 1–0 start.
